# `regr_slope`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
regr_slope(y, x)
```

Returns the slope of the linear regression line for non-null pairs in a group, where `y` is the dependent variable and `x` is the independent variable.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- regr_slope, example 1
> SELECT regr_slope(y, x) FROM VALUES (1, 1), (2, 2), (3, 3), (4, 4) AS tab(y, x);
1.0
```

```sql
-- regr_slope, example 2
> SELECT regr_slope(y, x) FROM VALUES (1, null) AS tab(y, x);
NULL
```

```sql
-- regr_slope, example 3
> SELECT regr_slope(y, x) FROM VALUES (null, 1) AS tab(y, x);
NULL
```

```sql
-- regr_slope, example 4
> SELECT regr_slope(y, x) FROM VALUES (1, 1), (2, null), (3, 3), (4, 4) AS tab(y, x);
1.0
```

```sql
-- regr_slope, example 5
> SELECT regr_slope(y, x) FROM VALUES (1, 1), (2, null), (null, 3), (4, 4) AS tab(y, x);
1.0
```
